primary_estimand: paired seed difference in valid in-domain target-hit rate, continuous minus binary
hit_definition: RDKit-valid, exactly one [Cu] and [Au], nearest-training Tanimoto >= 0.35, verifier tree SD < 0.35 log10(S/cm), and absolute target error < 0.5 log10(S/cm)

arms.binary: two-level condition embedding using the original 1e-4 S/cm threshold
arms.continuous: scalar normalized log10 conductivity projected to a learned soft-prefix embedding

forward_verifier: frozen 300-tree Morgan-fingerprint random forest trained only on generator-train structures; 20% structure-disjoint test is never used by either generator
interpretation_boundary: LiTFSI, 353 K, released HTP-MD protocol only; no salt, temperature, DP, architecture, or experimental conductivity claim
stopping_rule: all six runs finish 1000 optimizer steps and emit 300 samples each; no result-dependent reruns
multiplicity: one prespecified primary paired contrast; secondary metrics descriptive
